summary: The real gate this stage selects against is top5>=0.98, top100=1.00, and no teacher-forced top-1 regression from this config's own 0.850 baseline value (see accuracy_bar below). Every candidate that regresses top-1 below 0.850 (C01, C02, C03, C05, C08) fails that gate outright, regardless of speed. Among candidates that pass, one (C09, dense-MLP bf4) is marginally faster (+0.02%, inside this harness's own measurement noise) with a higher top-1 on this stage's short 100-token sample, but carries an already-documented real-weight 202k long-context accuracy regression (doc/optimized_decoder/README.md) invisible to that short sample; the rest that pass (C04, C06, C07) are measurably slower with no accuracy benefit. So this file records the already-shipped optimized-decoder/optimized-full-model config as the winner -- not because every alternative is strictly worse on every axis, but because none is a genuine, safely-evidenced improvement over it.

plumbing_added_this_stage: tt/model.py: GLM47FlashModel.from_pretrained gained lm_head_fidelity: str = "hifi2" (previously hardcoded MathFidelity.HiFi2); ck_lm_head is now built from FIDELITY[lm_head_fidelity]. Model instance also now exposes expert_dtype/weight_dtype/embed_dtype/lm_head_dtype/lm_head_fidelity/decoder_cls_name for the propagation check.

tt/optimized_decoder.py: OptimizedDecoder gained router_fidelity = "hifi4_fp32" class attribute (previously the decode router matmul's compute-kernel-config was hardcoded via the inherited ck_hifi4). from_state_dict now builds self.ck_router = _ck(dev, *FIDELITY[cls.router_fidelity]) and _router_scores_decode consumes self.ck_router instead of self.ck_hifi4. This is a decode-only knob: the (unmodified) prefill routing path (_router_scores in fused_decoder.py, reached via _moe_prefill) is not overridden by OptimizedDecoder and still reads the real self.ck_hifi4 (true HiFi4+fp32acc) directly, so router_fidelity has no effect on prefill routing -- consistent with the router_gate weight-group entry above, which discloses this explicitly.
proof_of_consumption: doc/datatype_sweep/runs/C00_baseline.json's policy_snapshot block: the per-layer sub-blocks (moe.wqkv_a_ds.dtype, moe.ck_attn.math_fidelity, moe.gate_w.dtype, moe.ck_router.math_fidelity, moe.ck_mlp_shared/dense.ck_mlp_dense, model.lm_head_weight.dtype, model.ck_lm_head.math_fidelity) and the KV-cache field (kv_cache_dtype, read from generator._kv_cache[0].dtype, the real allocated per-layer cache tensor) are introspected directly from real ttnn tensors and ttnn.init_device_compute_kernel_config objects on the constructed model/decoder layers, after a genuine build_generator(model_dir, mesh_device) call with zero overrides -- not the requested kwargs, the actually-built objects. (The top-level expert_dtype/weight_dtype/embed_dtype/lm_head_fidelity fields in that same snapshot are the model's own recorded constructor state, i.e. an echo of the requested kwarg, kept for a human-readable summary only -- they are not used as independent proof by the check below.)

That snapshot matches every field in this file. tests/check_selected_precision_config.py re-derives the comparison fresh (rebuilding nothing; it re-imports the live class/constructor defaults) and asserts the match programmatically against the introspected fields specifically.
